newsitem.title: USA: GE rejects Ohio school's plan for overpaid taxes.
newsitem.headline: GE rejects Ohio school's plan for overpaid taxes.

text.p: General Electric Co has rejected a hold-harmless plan for taxes it overpaid to an Ohio school district, according to a report Tuesday in the Beacon Journal.
The newspaper reported that the Ravenna School District's proposal to void a $467,000 refund due GE in March was deemed unacceptable by top managers in the company.
GE has proposed collecting the refund over the next two years, the newspaper said.
Ravenna is just one of 68 school districts in Ohio facing refunds of personal property taxes overpaid by GE companies between 1990 and 1995.
